_about: A filled-in brand.json, to read beside the real one. `engine init --from brand.example.json` would set a clone up from it with no questions; `engine validate` names the key and the fix for anything wrong. Every key is explained by the `_about` beside it; keys starting with `_` are notes and are ignored.
_brand_about: slug: lower-case, a letter first, 2 to 24 characters. It becomes the root stream, the launchd label prefix (com.<slug>), the environment prefix (<SLUG>_) and the keychain service (<slug>-comms); name any of label_prefix, env_prefix or keychain_service here only to override it.
_engine_about: The comms-engine plugin version this brand runs. `engine doctor` fails when the loaded plugin is another; move it after reading the release, as a tracked change.

acme.name: Acme
acme._narrator_about: The one register this stream speaks in. Two narrators are two streams.
acme._owner_about: confirmed or unset, never a name. Confirmed on a decision file under .atelier/memory/decisions/.
acme.objectives: intent engagement (saves, quote posts, substantive replies, reposts, link clicks); reach: not opted in
acme._autopilot_about: nothing: drafts only, nothing leaves. by switch: each kind of send follows its review mode below. Set once by a person at onboarding.
acme._channels_about: The stream's own handles, by channel: x, linkedin, telegram, discord, website.
acme._review_about: The default mode per kind of send: review (waits for a person) or auto (what passes the automatic checks goes out, what fails stays in the queue). A kind left out is review. `hold` is the statistics, partner and certification class. A kind may also be set per channel: {"like": {"x": "review", "linkedin": "auto"}}. Write the mode in quotes.
acme._drafts_only_about: all, none, or the channels that never send: ["Blog"].
acme._reactions_per_day_about: The most likes, reposts and quotes a day per channel. 0 or a kind left out sends none.
acme._quiet_hours_about: When nothing is sent, judged in the timezone of `engine setup autopilot`: weekends; before HH:MM and after HH:MM. `all hours until onboarded` blocks every send.
acme.blocked_topics: pricing; anything on the stealth denylist
acme.hold_for_review: statistics not in claims.md; a named counterparty not on the cleared list; any certification word
acme._pair_rules_about: A stream names another only under a rule here: [{"to": "<stream>", "rule": "the words the gate holds a line to", "basis": "the decision"}].

_drivers_about: write: native or composio. x_read and x_own: twitterapi or composio.
_jobs_about: true runs the job with the rest; false leaves it out of the all-jobs install.
_plugins_about: role: {use: "<plugin>:<agent or skill>", kind: agent or skill, version: the pinned plugin version, brief: the file under the engine's briefs/ that carries this repository's rules, fallback: what runs when the plugin is not installed}. Leave roles empty to keep engine.json's defaults.
